title: Forgeric version profile
description: Everything that varies between Minecraft versions. Adding support for a new version should mean adding one of these files, not editing Java.

profileVersion.description: Schema version of this file itself, so the installer can reject formats it predates.

minecraft.description: Minecraft version id exactly as Mojang publishes it, e.g. "26.2" or "1.21.1".

javaMajor.description: Java major version this Minecraft build requires.

obfuscated.description: True when Mojang still publishes client_mappings for this version. Forgeric has no runtime remapper, so the installer refuses obfuscated versions. This is the single flag that decides whether the bridge can work at all.

intermediary.description: Intermediary mapping version, or null when the game needs no mappings. Non-null implies obfuscated and therefore unsupported for now.

compat.description: Library versions both loaders must agree on. The bridge ships no Mixin or ASM of its own and relies on a single shared runtime; if these ever diverge between the two loaders, the profile is not usable as-is.

fabricApi.description: Whether the Fabric API bridge exists for this version. While false, Fabric mods depending on fabric-api will not load.
